import pathlib,json,datetime
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
r=pathlib.Path.cwd()
d,ref=audited_result(r/"results/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_03.json")
m=d["metrics"];assert d["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0 and not m["errors"]
assert m["independently_verified_pair_count"]==49 and m["unknown_attempt_source_count"]==0
diag,diagref=audited_result(r/"results/diag_g01_new_baseline_failures_01.json");assert diag["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0
stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
with (r/"STATUS.md").open("a") as f:
 f.write("\n\n### "+stamp+" — third G01 checkpoint and remaining Look diagnostics\n\n")
 f.write("Original independent checkpoint t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_03 completed: "+str(m["independently_verified_pair_count"])+" unique construction pairs, class counts "+json.dumps(m["independently_verified_by_class"],sort_keys=True)+". All12 sources are retained;802 attempts verified;3 duplicate proposals excluded by original identity. Formal review images: logs/review/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_03/. This is construction and recorded solvability acceptance only; fullT02/cache remains unmeasured. New9 Look pairs will be a separate cohort; frozen36 and50 denominators remain unchanged.\n\n")
 f.write("Baseline failures in FloorPlan18/214 are diagnosed from original evidence in results/diag_g01_new_baseline_failures_01.json: the same canonical TeleportFull arguments produce small nonzero agent-y readback differences after successful SetObjectPoses; non-anchor object poses and inventory remain exact. This is not the earlier signed-zero-only case. The original exact-agent baseline failure is retained; no tolerance or physics rule was changed.\n\n")
 f.write("New14 full-view checks: A retries708455→708547; B retries708475→708549→708566. Terminal black attempts keep native frames, UUID, cleanup proof and canonical allocation accounting. Retry708547 and708566 passed their own fresh per-GPU gates. FP210 pairs currently end with original native TeleportFull/Box collision errors and cannot be counted as no hidden-anchor trigger. Final authenticated census waits for all ended sources. No queued/running job was cancelled.\n")
print("THIRD_CHECKPOINT_STATUS_JSON: "+json.dumps({"created_at_utc":stamp,"checkpoint":ref,"counts":m["independently_verified_by_class"],"baseline_diagnosis":diagref},sort_keys=True))
config.scope: environment setup or diagnostic, not a research result

_meta.name: diag_third_checkpoint_status_01
